raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The clinical history of pneumonia-like symptoms unresponsive to antibiotics, combined with radiographic evidence of infiltrates clearing in one area (left upper lung) and appearing in new areas (right upper lobe and left lower lobe), is the classic presentation of migratory pulmonary infiltrates seen in Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
